notes.title: Trap skill + some bug fixes
notes.notes:
Camp Anguis' trap unit is now also available as a skill that you can find under the "distraction" tab. However, the main reason for this patch is that it fixes some bugs, most notably one that caused replays to break.

Changes made in revision 7937:

 Trap skill implemented
 Fixed a bug that caused replays to break under the following sequence of events:
[olist]
 Start a fight and change the camera distance (via mousewheel or options menu).
 Later, on the battle screen, use "Save & exit" to leave the fight.
 When continuing the fight use ice shield or pheromone decoy in one of the subsequent waves.
[/olist]Watching such a broken replay triggers an internal error detection mechanism that ends the fight and displays an error message.
 Fixed a bug that caused ice shield to sometimes ignore power boost.
 Fixed a spelling mistake on the game mode selection screen. Thanks to NatureBoy for notifying me!
 Fixed a minor memory leak that would have occurred under very unlikely circumstances.

notes.title: Scrollable leaderboards & bug fixes
notes.notes:
Changes made in revision 7859:

 Leaderboards are now scrollable.
 Circular light sources (for example energy flash, ice flash, frost shock) now take time dilation into account.
 Added two more face options.
 Fixed a potential integer overflow caused by very high power levels (more than 12,000%). This would have resulted in negative damage, which the game ignores. In other words, you would have stopped dealing damage if that had happened.
 Fixed a performance issue (i.e. very bad frame rate) when burning debris dropped down a steep cliff.
 Fixed leaderboards missing some entries when you haven't submitted a score yet.

notes.title: Hotfix for unsupported letters in user names
notes.notes:
Changes made  in revision 7834:

 Hotfix: User names with unsupported letters showed up as empty space in the leaderboard. Such letters or symbols are now replaced by question marks. I know this is still not ideal, but the fonts I have don't support the entire unicode set. I hope I can find a proper solution in the future.
